entries.session: Jul 7 2026 - SECURITY HARDENING + SELF-DEFENCE SENTINEL (security-hardening session)
entries.heading: Jul 7 2026 - SECURITY HARDENING + SELF-DEFENCE SENTINEL (security-hardening session)
entries.body:
Full security review of the whole app (4 independent audit passes: auth/authz, webhooks/external inputs, secrets/injection, crawling/indexing/headers) + direct core-file review. Complete write-up in `SECURITY.md`.

**Root vulnerability (Critical): the app had NO auth enforcement.** `getJarvisUser()` (`src/lib/supabase/get-user.ts`) runs the service-role client (RLS bypassed) and defaults to Nanda's UUID when no session exists, and NEVER returns null - so the documented `if (!user) return 401` guard could never fire. Middleware deliberately never blocked anyone. Net: every `/api` route was internet-reachable, read/write, as the owner, RLS off. Also fully indexable by search engines.

**Fix = fail-closed auth gate in `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`.** A valid Supabase session is now required for all `/dashboard` pages + owner `/api` routes. Genuinely-public routes are ALLOWLISTED (webhooks, `/api/portal/*`, `/api/ceo/portal/*`, `/api/payfast/*`, `/api/paystack/*`, `/api/ingest/*`, `/api/inngest`, shop intakes, OAuth callbacks, `/auth`, `/portal`, `/payfast`, static assets); `/api/portal/list` forced back private (it leaked every client's portal token - chained IDOR). RULE for future work: any new public endpoint MUST be added to that allowlist or it 401s. Next 14.2.29 is patched for CVE-2025-29927 so middleware auth is safe to rely on.

**Webhooks now FAIL CLOSED + constant-time** (several were fail-open): email-inbound, calcom, studio/inbox/webhook (added X-Hub-Signature-256 verify), engineering/github/webhook (was `===`). Shared helper `src/lib/security/webhook.ts` (`safeEqual`, `verifyHmacSha256`). ingest/payment + stock-sync-receiver constant-time + length-checked (was crashable to 500).

**XSS / HTML-injection fixed:** CEO email viewer now renders untrusted inbound HTML in a SANDBOXED iframe (no allow-scripts) instead of a bypassable regex + dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Added `escapeHtml` + `sanitizeOrFilterTerm` to `src/lib/security/sanitize.ts`, applied to portal message notification emails, `src/lib/finance/invoice-html.ts`, and all `src/lib/docs/templates/*` (invoice/quote/proposal/sow/shell). Memoir search `.or()` filter-injection guarded.

**Headers (`next.config.mjs`):** added `public/robots.txt` (disallow all incl. GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot) + `noindex` metadata + `X-Robots-Tag`, `poweredByHeader:false`, COOP/CORP, `X-XSS-Protection:0`, `microphone=()`, removed unused CDN hosts (jsdelivr/unpkg) from CSP. CSP still has unsafe-inline/eval (Next needs them; nonce migration is a TODO).

**Security Sentinel - JarvisOS now detects its own risk, flags it, and announces the fix (NEW):**
- `src/lib/security/sentinel.ts` - `recordSecurityEvent()` (fire-and-forget) + `assessSecurityPosture()`: config checks (missing signing keys / fail-open conditions, prod-only) + live signals (auth_401 from the middleware gate, webhook_sig_fail from the webhooks, injection shared with the AI threat monitor). Every finding carries a concrete solution. Redis keys `jarvis:sec:*`.
- `src/inngest/os/security-sentinel.ts` - cron every 30 min: assess, snapshot to Redis, notify Nanda (with top solutions) on high/critical, deduped ~twice/day per level. Registered in `src/inngest/index.ts`.
- `GET /api/os/security/status` - owner-only live posture, ready for a dashboard card.

**CI:** `.github/workflows/typecheck.yml` runs `npm run type-check` (tsc) on GitHub runners for every push/PR to master - catches type + unescaped-interpolation regressions that `next build` skips (ignoreBuildErrors). Never runs on the laptop.

**Vercel env:** generated + pushed `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` + `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (prod/preview/dev) via REST API. `META_APP_SECRET` intentionally NOT set (must come from Meta dashboard).

**Owner TODO before prod:** preview-deploy and verify login + a real payment + a client portal link; logged-out `curl /api/finance/transactions` must be 401; rotate `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (was reachable as admin); set `META_APP_SECRET`; paste the CALCOM secret into Cal.com. Open follow-ups: RLS migration off service-role for request-path queries, nonce-based CSP, portal-token expiry enforcement.

**Not committed-then-pushed:** committed locally only (no push), per instruction. Real-env build not run this session; the new CI typecheck is the verification gate on push.

**★ SECURITY — the fail-closed gate NEVER RAN in production (`640fb5e`).** This corrects the "SECURITY HARDENING" entry above: the gate logic lived in `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`, but the ENTRY `middleware.ts` sat at the **repo root** while the app uses `src/` — so Next.js silently ignored it. Every `/api` route still returned Nanda's real data (finance wealth, marketing, everything) to any unauthenticated caller. ALSO the reason server-side session auth never worked: the browser client persists the session under `storageKey:'jarvis-auth'` (cookies) but every server client used Supabase's DEFAULT key. FIX: moved entry to `src/middleware.ts` + shared `SUPABASE_STORAGE_KEY='jarvis-auth'` (`src/lib/supabase/constants.ts`) on `getSupabaseServerClient` + the middleware client + middleware honours Bearer too. **Verified live BEFORE and AFTER deploy** (round-tripped a real session cookie through @supabase/ssr's own encoding to prove no lock-out; then curled prod: unauth `/api/finance/dashboard`→401, with-session→200, `/dashboard`→307). Studio owner also un-blanked (`799160a`, `6f09d3b`): session-refresh retry on the page + owner-fallback when a request carries NO bearer token at all (a supplied-but-failed token never upgrades a collaborator).

**STUDIO — collaborator marketing infra + THE AGENCY (`460108c`, `afef3db`, `dd8dac1`, `63aa46c`):** Zee/Jae brand hubs now surface the real Marketing-wing content (Brand DNA + Posts + Collabs) for their assigned brands via a slug→marketing-key map, scoped by assignment (404 on unassigned — verified as Zee/Jae). Gotchas: `brand_posts` has no `published_at` col; `marketing_content_bank` isn't brand-keyed (dropped from hub). Seeded elite Sanyu DNA+posts. **My Workspace → "The Agency"** (`20260707_agency_workspace.sql`): `studio_workspace_brands` became CLIENTS (retainer/package/posts-per-month/status pipeline/contact); Command deck (live MRR + ARR + active clients + posts-due + at-risk radar), cross-client content pipeline (idea→draft→client_review→approved→scheduled→posted), calendar, and a **7-module/30-lesson SA-grounded Agency Academy** (`src/lib/studio/agency-academy.ts`) + 6 templates. Verified live: created a client → MRR R5,000/ARR R60,000/12 posts committed.

**FINANCE (`d8e3659`, `dd47c35`):** CFO chat made **omniscient** — `buildRichFinanceContext` now injects a full live snapshot every message (MTD income/expense/net, spend-by-category, bank accounts, wealth, latest P&L, savings goals, AR, 12 recent txns) so he's never out of date. Then restructured cash: new `finance_bank_accounts` table = source of truth (each account business|personal); moved TymeBank(business R5,232.81)+ABSA(personal) out of `joy_accounts`; Bank Accounts card on the finance home (tap-to-update balance, stamps `synced_at`); CFO reads it. Transactions list got a **Business/Personal ledger filter + per-row badge** (verified: business=23 rows all business, personal=6 all personal — no blur). Also cleaned Nanda's live data per her corrections (salon R500 = single Sanyu marketing expense, removed the duplicate reimbursement, R288.02→personal/herb). Owner password reset + verified (self-serve reset page doesn't exist yet; used admin API). `ADMIN_SECRET` she added to `.env.local` is unused/inert — her real login is her Supabase password.

**VERIFICATION THIS SESSION:** full `next build` is too heavy on this box (gets killed mid-typecheck), so the gate was **esbuild transform-check (syntax/JSX) on every changed file + live end-to-end verification** by minting real sessions (magic-link generate→verify) for Nanda/Zee/Jae and curling the deployed endpoints. entries.body:
Nanda live-tested on mobile and flagged: form Save buttons buried on phones; Cycle wing "cycle day + energy stuck on 1/5, can't edit"; nutrition should auto-calc from a meal; "cycle + body must complement each other"; and a side-quest — resend Jae's Studio invite. Each pull revealed a deeper issue. All shipped + verified via the real-env build gate (`node --env-file=../.env.vercel.template next build` → `BUILD_EXIT=0`).

**MOBILE FORMS (`94b601e`):** every data-entry form shares `FormModal` (`src/components/os/FormKit.tsx`) with a pinned Save footer, yet Save was still buried on phones. Cause: the overlay was `fixed inset-0`, whose `bottom:0` is the LAYOUT viewport — on mobile that edge sits behind the browser address/toolbar, so `items-end` pinned the footer into that hidden zone. Fix: `fixed inset-x-0 top-0` + `height: 100dvh` (dynamic viewport tracks the visible area). One change → all 95 forms.

**CYCLE WING (`8546931`):**
- *Editable logs* — the day/energy inputs forced `parseInt(v) || 1` / `|| 5` on every keystroke, so clearing to retype snapped back to 1 and 5 (un-editable; every save carried energy/mood 5). Now `number | ''` (clears + retypes, `inputMode="numeric"`); empty is a validation error. Also removed a `+1` in the prefill that defaulted "Log Today" to *tomorrow's* day.
- *Irregular / late periods* — `/api/cycle/phase` wrapped the day count `% DEFAULT_CYCLE_LENGTH`, silently resetting a late cycle to "menstrual" though no period had arrived. Now it does NOT wrap: HOLDS in luteal past the expected length and reports `days_late`/`is_late` (added to `CycleSignal`); only a logged period (day 1) resets. Route + `cycle-daily.ts` cron + logs POST all publish consistent phase/day/lateness; `cycle_day` max widened 35→60; dashboard shows a "period N days late" banner + `PhaseWheel` clamps day>35 to luteal.
- *Auto meal nutrients* — meals were stored as text only, so gap bars always read 0. New Haiku worker `src/inngest/cycle/meal-analyze.ts` (event `CYCLE_MEAL_ANALYZE`) estimates whole-meal calories/protein/carbs/fat/iron → folds into `nutrition_logs` totals; `/api/cycle/nutrition/log` fires it; `daily-gaps` now returns the `log` (+ SAST date fix); UI shows "Analysing nutrients…" then per-meal kcal.
- *Cycle ↔ Body* — both wings key `nutrition_logs` on `(user_id, log_date)` = one shared daily row; aligned Body's default date to SAST so late-evening meals don't split across two rows. A meal logged in either wing now feeds both.

**EMAIL INFRA — the real reason team invites reach nobody (`4f8deda` + Management API):** resending Jae's invite exposed a stack of failures.
- *Root cause of Jae specifically:* the email on file was `jaemalavila02@gmail.com` but her real one is `jael…` (missing "l"). Every send hard-**bounced** → Resend **suppressed** the address. Confirmed via Resend `GET /emails/{id}` (`last_event: bounced`/`suppressed`). Fixed her email on the auth account + `studio_members`, resent, **verified `last_event: delivered`**. Lesson: check Resend `last_event`, not just a 200 from the send API.
- *Dead keys:* shared `RESEND_API_KEY` (400) + `MIREMBEMUSE_RESEND_API_KEY` (401) invalid; `CREATIVELYNANDA_RESEND_API_KEY` is the one verified domain. Made it the working default: `sendEmail` from-address → `nanda@creativelynanda.co.za`; `resolveResendKey` fallback → creativelynanda key. `/api/studio/invite` rewritten to `generateLink` (invite/recovery) + send via the creativelynanda identity instead of Supabase's broken mailer.
- *Supabase Auth SMTP was UNCONFIGURED* (`smtp_host: null`) → using the rate-limited default mailer that rejected sends ("email invalid"). PATCHed `/v1/projects/ywkbuqqlnuyidqseymrl/config/auth` → Resend SMTP (`smtp.resend.com`, port `'465'` — MUST be a string or 400, user `resend`, pass = creativelynanda key, sender `noreply@creativelynanda.co.za`). Verified: anon `resetPasswordForEmail` now succeeds.
- *Redirect allow-list* only had the `*.vercel.app` URLs, so team links (`jarvis.mirembemuse.co.za`) were rejected at click time — appended it to `uri_allow_list`.

**GIT/OPS GOTCHA:** `git push` hung at `git credential-manager get` (GCM token expired → interactive OAuth impossible in this shell; reads still fine). entries.body:
Nanda: "my dashboard doesn't show today's todos / weekly synthesis says week of 5 July / rituals page is bare / make my menu pink / sparks poems aren't editable." Root causes found and fixed.

**DASHBOARD READS THE WRONG TASK TABLE (the big one):** two task tables, `todos` and `os_tasks`, with no sync. Every "add task" UI writes `todos`; the home dashboard's queue/board/arc all read `os_tasks` — which nothing writes to — so added tasks never appeared. Repointed all dashboard task surfaces to `todos`: command queue → `/api/todos/command-queue`, `/api/os/agenda` tasks + `/api/os/todays-arc` urgent → `todos`, and "Done" → `PATCH /api/todos {status:'done'}` (which also now earns `os.task_complete` XP). Fixed the habit auto-populate `build` read (`os_tasks status='completed'` — a value its CHECK forbids → never true) to `todos status='done'`. The 6h-cached Today's Arc now invalidates (`jarvis:todays-arc:{userId}`) on any todo change. See memory `reference-task-tables`.

**WEEKLY SYNTHESIS "week of 5 July":** the card *preferred* the CWSE source (`os_weekly_synthesis`, stuck at Jul 5, cron rarely runs) over the fresher `weekly_synthesis` (Jul 12). Now it shows whichever source is freshest AND self-heals: extracted `src/lib/os/weekly-synthesis-generate.ts`, added `POST /api/os/weekly-synthesis` (regenerate current week on demand), and the card regenerates when the freshest data is behind the current week + labels the week honestly.

**RITUALS BACKGROUND:** the Sankofa rituals page set an opaque `var(--os-bg)` root that covered the shell's per-route painting (`cosmicFluidPour`, already mapped in `wings/images.ts`). Made the root transparent → the background shows.

**PINK HAMBURGER:** owner's mobile drawer + desktop sidebar (`jarvis-drawer`/`jarvis-sidebar` in JarvisShell) now use `/zee-backgrounds/zee-1.jpg` (pink gradient) with a dark readability overlay, owner-only (collaborators keep their own theming).

**SPARKS POEMS EDITABLE:** vault pieces (`sanctuary_workshop_sparks`) were display-only. Added `PATCH`/`DELETE` to `/api/sanctuary/workshop`; sparks vault items now open an edit modal (edit title/body, save, delete, or "Move to Poetry" → creates a `sanctuary_poems` row in a "Sparks" collection).

**SUPABASE TYPES REGENERATED** — `src/types/supabase.ts` now includes engineering_commits, engineering_brick_mastery, scholar_reading (the 3 tables added the prior session).

**MUTATION-DRIVEN WING SIGNALS (Jul 16):** the dashboard wing-status dots were cron-only (10-min lag). Extracted every wing's signal computation into `src/lib/os/wing-signals.ts` (single source of truth) exposing `publishWingSignal(userId, wing)` (instant, one wing) and `publishAllWingSignals(userId)` (cron). Refactored `wing-signal-publisher` to use it. Wired instant publish into the mutations that flip a dot: engineering alert action, sanyu stock/threshold change, sankofa crisis create+resolve, consulting milestone complete, portal messages read. Fixed 2 signal↔UI mismatches found en route: engineering counted `resolved_at` (never set) → now `actioned=false` + not-expired (matches the alerts GET); sankofa counted `sankofa_crises` → now `crises` (the table the Crisis Centre actually writes). entries.body:
Follow-on to the Email Station session. Two deferred architectural items + a re-run of the wing audit that a session limit had cut off. All commits deploy-verified green (`fcc0b34`, `4484268`).

**OS INTELLIGENCE READS THE CANONICAL TASK TABLE (`fcc0b34`):** six OS-intelligence readers still read the orphaned, empty `os_tasks` — so `wing-snapshot`, `energy-budget`, `cwse`, `wing-health-monitor`, `todays-arc-cron`, and `morning-brief-auto` all saw ZERO tasks (the nervous system was half-blind). Migration `todos_add_energy_columns_20260716` adds `energy_required`/`estimated_minutes`/`task_type` to todos (nullable) so `energy-budget`'s `select('energy_required')` doesn't 400. Verified status values (`open|in_progress|done`) + `completed_at` filters port cleanly between the two tables. Only remaining `os_tasks` refs are the orphaned `/api/os/tasks*` routes (the `/dashboard/tasks` page already redirects to `/dashboard/todos`).

**COMEBACK PROTOCOL SEES THE CRISIS CENTRE (`fcc0b34`):** the convergence detector (`os/comeback-protocol.ts`) only watched `sankofa_crises`, so a crisis the user manually logs in the Crisis Centre (the separate `crises` table) never fed the protocol. Now also counts active `crises` rows as a convergence signal. Deliberately did NOT merge the two tables — investigation showed they are *distinct features* with incompatible schemas (Crisis Centre = manual crisis→AI triage+support-network on `crises`; Comeback = auto-detected signal convergence→7/30-day rebuild JSON in `sankofa_crises.ai_analysis`), each with a separately-working worker→route→card loop. A force-merge would risk a sensitive feature for no real gain.

**APP-WIDE WING AUDIT (`4484268`):** parallel read-only agents audited ceo/consulting/ux/portal, body/cycle/sanctuary/scholar, finance/marketing/engineering/os — every finding confirmed on both sides. Wings are unusually well-wired (every page fetch resolves, every Link has a page). Fixed the confirmed high-value defects (all form↔Zod↔DB-CHECK mismatches — same class as the bug-hunt waves):
- **Consulting Board** — `Add Action` 400'd on 5/6 types incl the default, and `Close` always 500'd (form enums vs the CHECK). `ACTION_TYPES` → the 7 valid values (default `decision`); Close → `resolved`.
- **Consulting New Engagement** — sent `null` for `.optional()` fields (Zod wants `undefined`) → 400 on the common path; `notes` had no schema key (column is `description`); status `completed`→`complete`; and a Zod-flatten error object was rendered as a React child (crash) → stringified.
- **Consulting Meetings** — `action_items` are `{task,owner,due}` objects (digest worker) but rendered as raw children → `[object Object]`/crash; now renders `a.task`.
- **Engineering Vercel grid** — the cached / no-`VERCEL_API_TOKEN` branch returned `deployments` but the page reads `apps` → empty grid; returns `apps`.
- **Sanctuary Sketch** — removed the no-op "Fetch today's lesson" placeholder button (the working VideoPanel already covers it).

**REMAINING AUDIT BACKLOG (confirmed, logged in memory `project-wing-audit-jul16`):** [P1] marketing hub "Generate Post" button (POSTs a no-AI insert route → 422); [P2] engineering security card is a hardcoded array (live `/api/os/security/status` unused); [P3] orphaned duplicate route trees at `src/app/{body,cycle,sanctuary,scholar}/**` served at bare URLs; [P3] AI-enrichment routes with no dashboard trigger (poem analyse, workshop develop, recital coach, scholar-africa reflect/edit/delete); [P3] `/dashboard/marketing/account` not in nav; [P3] ux list GETs omit `user_id`; [P3] orphan `consulting_milestones` table + `subscriptions` MRR column check.

entries.heading: Jul 17 2026 — MOON UNIFICATION · AUTO-COMMITS · BUFFER GRAPHQL · MARKETING FOOTPRINT (all deploy-verified green)
entries.body:
A single long session that closed the Jul-16 marketing/engineering backlog and then built the Monday-launch marketing spine end to end. Deploy method throughout: commit → push master → Vercel prod build (full type-check) → read status via Vercel CLI/MCP. Local `next build` is unusably slow here; Vercel is the true gate and a failed build never promotes.

**MOON / ASTROLOGY UNIFIED (`e176e19`).** Prompted by "is the moon wiring right?" — the phase maths was *correct* (new moon was Jul 14; today reads waxing crescent, matches almanac) but there were **three** implementations disagreeing on **33% of days** (238/730 over two years): `astro.ts` (SunCalc, right) vs byte-identical hand-rolled linear approximations in `sankofa/moon/route.ts` and `os/wing-signals.ts`. The hand-rolled new-moon window (`fraction < 0.03`) never wrapped past 1.0, so the run-up to every new moon was misfiled as waning_crescent — on 2026-08-12 (0.0% illum, the real new moon) Sankofa rituals would read "Rest, surrender" instead of "plant seeds, offer gin to the ancestors", a day late every cycle. Now `astro.ts` `getMoonPhase()` is the single source (`MOON_PHASE_KEYS` = the Postgres enum); New wraps both ends; emoji **mirrored for the southern hemisphere** (from East London the crescent lights the opposite limb); `moon_illumination` documented as 0–100. Verified against almanac (Jul 21 first-qtr 50.3% lit, Jul 29 full 99.9%).

**MARKETING GENERATE + SECURITY CARD (`e176e19`).** [P1] the hub "Generate" tab could never work — it never sent `content` (schema-required → 422) and read `j.data.caption` when the route returns `{item}`, with no AI at all. Deleted the dead tab; hub + calendar empty-day CTA now link to the working `/dashboard/marketing/generate`. [P2] the Engineering security card rendered a hardcoded `pass:true` array ("RLS on every table", "Arcjet on all routes") while the live `assessSecurityPosture()` sat unused. Now renders real posture (level/headline/findings+solutions); an unreachable route reads **"unknown", never "secure"**. The sentinel was already proactive (30-min cron, notifies with solutions) — only the UI was lying.

**ENGINEERING COMMITS LOG THEMSELVES (`e176e19`).** `engineering_commits` had **zero rows** — the manual logger was never used once. The GitHub reader already pulled commits + BUILD_JOURNEY docs but only on a button press (last sync was 10 days stale). New `engineering/github-sync` cron (6h) drives `syncAppWorkspaces`; `syncCommitLog` mirrors commits into `engineering_commits`, **diff-on-sha not upsert** (the unique index is partial → Postgres can't infer it from a bare ON CONFLICT). `per_page` 12→100. **XP only for commits in the last 48h**: awardXP doesn't dedupe, so the 897-commit backfill would have injected ~17,940 retroactive XP into architect_mind — capped it; verified live 897 in / 52 in-window / 52 XP awarded, exact. **`Nanda-Regine/JarvisOS` was missing from APP_REPOS** (the OS's own repo) + added CreativelyNanda; verified SankofaSessions/WatchSankofa repos 404. Manual logger + POST route deleted → read-only `CommitFeedCard`.

**BUFFER REWRITTEN FOR GRAPHQL (`5d1036f`).** `buffer.ts` targeted the dead REST API (`bufferapp.com/1`) which needs an OAuth client Buffer no longer issues — the key is a **GraphQL personal key** (`api.buffer.com/graphql`). Rewritten from live introspection: `createPost`→`PostActionPayload` union (typed errors), `deletePost`→a *different* union `DeletePostPayload`, `assets` a required non-null list, `customScheduled`+`dueAt` for exact time, errors arrive with HTTP 200. **Verified live** (create→delete round-trip, queue left clean). entries.session: Jul 20–21 2026 — THE VISUAL ASSET SYSTEM (P1–P7 + polish, tests green)
entries.heading: Jul 20–21 2026 — THE VISUAL ASSET SYSTEM (P1–P7 + polish, tests green)
entries.body:
The marketing wing gained a full visual production line: the text brain's posts now become on-brand **carousels, covers, and reels** — rendered, vaulted, one tap from Canva, and downloadable as MP4 — across all 9 branded identities. Verified locally throughout by rendering real PNGs/MP4s through headless Chrome + ffmpeg and *looking at them* (Vercel is still the deploy gate; local `next build` type-checks nothing — `ignoreBuildErrors:true`).

**THE ENGINE DECISION.** The magazine "spreads" were originally designed in Claude (HTML) → exported PNG → vaulted in Canva. There is **no editable Canva master** and the Canva API can't build these bespoke layouts. So the editorial engine is **Claude HTML → headless Chrome → PNG/MP4**, not Canva Bulk. Canva remains the *destination* (import the finished asset), not the *builder*.

**P1–P3 — the render engine + vault.** `src/lib/marketing/magazine/`: `schema.ts` (the `MagazineFields` contract + per-brand `MAGAZINE_TOKENS`), `render.ts` (`MagazineFields` → the exact locked "Field Manual" HTML; contrast computed from brand tokens via luminance/darken/lighten so cloning a brand is just tokens; container-query units so one stylesheet renders at any size), `png.ts` (headless-Chrome rasteriser — `@sparticuz/chromium` on serverless, local Chrome/Edge in dev). Migration `create_marketing_asset_vault`: tables `marketing_assets` + `asset_templates`, RLS, public `marketing-assets` bucket. `vault.ts` is the data layer.

**P4 — the render worker + text-arc wire.** Extended `VisualBrief` with a self-contained `magazine` brief (ratio/section/slides); `magazine/brief.ts` maps a generated `brand_posts` row → `MagazineFields[]` (explicit brief, else a caption-derived fallback; returns `[]` for un-cloned brands — never throws). Event `marketing/asset.render` + `asset-render` worker (save draft → render PNGs on one browser → upload → mark). `batch-sync` auto-enqueues renders for magazine posts. Routes `POST/GET /api/marketing/magazine/render`. UI: a **📰 Render → Vault** button in the post's `VisualBriefPanel` and a new **Visual Vault** gallery (`/dashboard/marketing/vault`) that polls while renders are in flight.

**P5 — Send to Canva (dormant-safe).** `canva.ts` imports a rendered PNG's public URL into Canva as an *editable design* via the Connect **URL-import** flow (`POST /v1/url-imports` → poll job → `design.edit_url`). Migration added `canva_edit_url/view_url/pushed_at`. Event `marketing/canva.push` + `canva-push` worker + `POST /api/marketing/magazine/canva` (503 when not connected). Vault lightbox gains **🎨 Send to Canva → Open in Canva ↗** with a "Canva ✓" badge.

**P6 — reels as real MP4.** Reused the same `png.ts` engine to render the 9:16 reel frames, then **ffmpeg-static** stitches them into a 1080×1920 H.264 MP4 with cross-fades, a **Ken-Burns** push-in, and a silent AAC bed (so IG/TikTok accept it) — pixel-identical to the vault stills, no second design system. Chose ffmpeg-from-frames over Remotion (which would need @remotion/lambda + AWS). Event `marketing/asset.video` + `asset-video` worker (one reel = one vault row with poster `image_url` + `video_url`) + `POST /api/marketing/magazine/video`. Vault plays the MP4 inline (▶ overlay, `<video>` in the lightbox, Download MP4). **Verified by encoding the VarsityOS reel → 10.80s / 1080×1920 / h264 / 30fps and viewing extracted frames** (correct design, edge text safe under the 5% zoom, cross-fade + motion clean).

**P7 — cloned the Field Manual tokens for all 9 brands.** VarsityOS, Mirembe Muse, AdminOS, StokveLOS, K53 DrillMaster, Watch Sankofa, Sankofa Sessions, Nanda (personal), and Sanyu — each authored from its **real dossier palette** (`src/data/studio/dossiers/*`). `selves`/`bb_mothership` stay gated (no editorial presence). Verified by rendering real PNGs for the three most divergent palettes (Mirembe emerald/ivory, Sanyu burgundy/cream, K53 asphalt/caution-gold) and viewing them — all on-brand with correct contrast and gold money accents.

**POLISH (Jul 21).**
- **Canva OAuth auto-refresh** — `getCanvaAccessToken()` now supports a refresh-token flow (`CANVA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` + `CANVA_REFRESH_TOKEN`): access tokens cached in Redis to their expiry, the rotating refresh token persisted back so the connection self-heals. Backward-compatible with a static `CANVA_API_KEY`. Fully dormant-safe.
- **Ken-Burns motion** — subtle centred zoompan push-in per reel frame (`d=clipFrames` single-image recipe; cap 1.05 so edge text stays in frame). Fixed the zoompan-with-looped-input frame-count bug that first collapsed the clip to 3.4s.
- **Auto-video for reels** — `batch-sync` now routes 9:16 magazine posts to the video worker (poster + MP4) and spreads/covers to the PNG renderer.
- **Serverless bundle fix** — `next.config` marks `ffmpeg-static` + `@sparticuz/chromium` + `puppeteer-core` as external and traces the ffmpeg binary into `/api/inngest`, so their binaries aren't bundled into every function.

**TESTS (Jul 21).** `magazine-brief` (10), `canva` dormant-safe (7), `magazine-video` guards (3), and a **marketing-wing route smoke** that loads all 33 `/api/marketing` routes and asserts each exports a handler + drives the magazine routes' validation/gate paths (503/400/422) offline. Full marketing surface **123/123 green**. Fixed a stale `BRANDS` unit test (8 → the real 11).

**VERIFICATION NOTES.** Safe local gates used throughout: the `tsx` test runner (per-file transpile) and `esbuild` for JSX (tsc stays banned — it crashes this laptop; `next build` type-checks nothing). Real PNG/MP4 renders viewed for visual confidence. Worker count 248 → 250 (`asset-render`, `canva-push`, `asset-video`).

**OWNER ACTIONS TO GO FULLY LIVE.**
- **Canva:** set `CANVA_CLIENT_ID` + `CANVA_CLIENT_SECRET` + `CANVA_REFRESH_TOKEN` (Connect app with `design:content:write`) so Send-to-Canva self-heals; or drop a fresh static `CANVA_API_KEY` for a one-off test.
- **Serverless video:** confirm on a Vercel deploy that the ffmpeg binary lands in `/api/inngest` (file-tracing) and the function stays under size limits — if not, split `asset-video` to its own function/external encoder. Dormant-safe gate means it degrades to *skip*, never crash, if ffmpeg is stripped.
- **Types regen:** `supabase gen types` to type `marketing_assets` (+ the new `canva_*`/`video_url` columns) and `asset_templates` — currently `as any` per convention.

Detail in memory `project-visual-asset-system`, `feedback-backend-frontend-sync`.

entries.session: FRAMED SCREENSHOT PLATES + DETERMINISTIC RECORDER (Aug 3 2026, session II)
entries.heading: Deterministic recorder (record.mjs v2, commits 51e08ef+)
entries.body:
Playwright's realtime `recordVideo` dropped compositor frames on this laptop → framer springs rendered as glitches. v2 is Remotion-style: virtual clock owns rAF + performance.now, scroll computed per frame in Node, one CDP screenshot per frame, ffmpeg at constant 30fps. **Battle scars, all encoded in the file:**
1. `performance.now` must micro-advance per read UNBOUNDED (0.01ms) with peak-tracked monotonic ticks — busy-wait spins hang forever on a frozen clock, and a 30ms crawl cap just moves the hang to any wait longer than the cap.
2. CDP `captureScreenshot` returns CSS pixels unless `clip.scale` is set; clip coords are PAGE-absolute so `y` must track scrollY (y:0 = black frames).
3. `optimizeForSpeed: true` wedges the capture pipeline a few frames in.
4. A 1-device-px damage dot alternating #000/#010101 every tick guarantees the compositor has a frame to hand over.
5. Long-delay timers (>5s) are swallowed once recording starts — frame capture stretches ~20s of virtual time over minutes of real time, long enough for timed redirects to destroy the page (VarsityOS /upgrade).
6. Frame tmpdirs live in the OS temp dir — OneDrive sync EPERM'd cleanup inside the repo tree.
7. Stalled captures fall back to duplicating the previous frame (invisible at 30fps); >60 consecutive dups aborts the page.

entries.session: THE NIGHT OF THE SILENT FAILURES (July 29–30 2026)
entries.heading: The theme
entries.body:
Seven separate features **looked** built, had code, had docs — and had never once worked in production. Each failed silently, so nothing ever said so. Tonight they were found one by one, each by evidence rather than guesswork.

1. **No browser.** `@sparticuz/chromium`'s binary was never traced into the Inngest function, so EVERY magazine render since the vault was built died with "input directory does not exist". That was the real answer to *"where are my templates?"* — the design system, ten brand token sets and the render engine were all real; they simply had no browser to draw with. One `outputFileTracingIncludes` entry.
2. **Blocked images.** `res.cloudinary.com` was missing from the CSP `img-src`, so 65 Cloudinary-hosted assets — Zee's uploads, every VelvetFist card — rendered as broken files for everyone.
3. **Approval could never succeed.** The calendar PATCH route set `updated_at`, a column `content_calendar` does not have, so every approve/edit/reschedule 500'd. 264 rows sat unpublishable their whole lifetime. (Self-inflicted the same night — found by the audit that followed.)
4. **Two gates, never connected.** `publish-scheduled` required `approved = true` while the UI only set `status = 'scheduled'`. Lifetime posts published through that lane: zero.
5. **Half-painted cards.** Screenshots fired on `load`, not on decode, so large photos were still painting — cards shipped with a black lower half. Now every image must `decode()` plus a double rAF before capture.
6. **All-or-nothing rendering.** One step rendered every slide; a single slow slide blew the function budget and discarded EVERY finished PNG with it (410 queued → 43 landed). Each slide is now its own checkpointed step: 43 → 345 rendered on the next run.
7. **Two post systems wearing one name.** `brand_posts` (what every page displayed, 15 days stale) vs `content_calendar` (what all four workers write to, fresh hourly). The pipeline looked empty while it was full. Now unified: one list, one approve action, `cal:` id prefixes routing writes to the right table, worker-written posts badged **⚙️ auto-publishes**.

entries.session: FULL SYSTEMS AUDIT — 273 workers, 684 routes, 370 tables (July 30 2026)
entries.heading: The four criticals (all live exposures, all closed)
entries.body:
1. **Every Sanyu customer order was public.** The RLS policy read `user_id = auth.uid() OR user_id IS NULL` with `WITH CHECK (true)` — and all 7 orders had `user_id` NULL, because the intake route never set it. Anyone with the anon key (it ships in every browser) could pull customer phones and shipping addresses, insert fake paid orders, or delete real ones. Backfilled, owner-only policy, intake now stamps the owner.
2. **Every client portal conversation was world-readable and world-writable** — `portal_messages` carried `SELECT`/`INSERT` policies with `USING (true)` for role `public`. An attacker could read all client threads and inject messages that appear to come from the studio (invoice-fraud vector inside paid portals). Dropped; the real client path uses the service-role client and is unaffected.
3. **Payroll and the whole ledger were open to any logged-in user** — 16 tables with `TO authenticated USING (true)`. Studio collaborators hold genuine JWTs, so the HTTP-layer confinement meant nothing against a direct PostgREST call. Now owner-scoped.
4. **Five owner-privileged routes were reachable unauthenticated.** `/api/portal/` is public for the token-gated client portal, but `questionnaire`, `sow/[id]` and `git-translate` sat under it calling only `getJarvisUser()` — which *by design never fails* and falls back to the OWNER identity with an RLS-bypassing client. An anonymous request was served as Nanda. New `FORCE_PRIVATE_PREFIXES` (the existing exact-path Set couldn't cover `[id]` children). Same dead-gate pattern made `GET /api/engineering/feedback` an anonymous read of all feedback — now a real session check.

**The lesson worth keeping: `getJarvisUser()` is a data accessor, not an auth gate.** Any route relying on it to reject an anonymous caller is open.

Result: **256 calendar rows, zero posts published in the system's lifetime**, while four AI lanes kept generating into it daily. Both signals now mean "released". Compounding it, `<input type="datetime-local">` emits `2026-07-30T14:30`, which `z.string().datetime()` rejects — so manual scheduling 422'd every time. The schema now accepts it and normalises SAST→UTC (a date with no time stays rejected).

entries.heading: Money and AI safety
entries.body:
- `consulting/invoice-generate` had no idempotence guard on a `retries: 3` function fired from two places — a replay minted a second invoice number and emailed the client a second invoice. Guarded.
- `sanyu/order-notify` did read-modify-write on stock inside retried steps: a mid-step failure double-decremented inventory, re-pushed wrong stock to the live shop, and inflated lifetime spend enough to falsely upgrade a customer's Angel tier. Now claims the order once (`notified_at`).

entries.session: FULL SYSTEMS AUDIT — 273 workers, 684 routes, 370 tables (July 30 2026)
entries.heading: What the audit found healthy (worth stating)
entries.body:
RLS is enabled on 100% of ~370 tables — the exposures were permissive policies, not missing RLS, and 16 zero-policy tables are the safest possible state (deny-all). Ten of eleven webhooks already verify signatures constant-time and fail closed (Crisp was the exception; fixed). No `NEXT_PUBLIC_` secret leaks, no service-role client in any component, no secret values logged, comprehensive security headers, zero dead fetches across 1,116 call sites, and the portal-token IDOR closed earlier still holds.

entries.session: Empire specialist audit + the template system's finish line (July 29 2026)
entries.heading: The template finish line (this session's build)
entries.body:
The deep-dive found the design system complete but the **production loop** around it broken in six places. All fixed:
1. **statement is now AI-emittable** — added to `MAGAZINE_SLIDE_VARIANTS` with `attribution` on the slide brief and full statement/testimonial rules in the system prompt. The highest-recognition card no longer requires hand-built fields.

3. **Ratio guard** — `legalVariant()` in brief.ts: a 9:16 cover/module/cta coerces to its reel sibling (and reels coerce to paged bodies on 4:5/16:9) instead of silently rendering the wrong body. Module folios renumber post-coercion.
4. **Ad/hook A/B** — `alt_headlines` on cover/reel_hook slides fans out one asset per hook (capped at 2 alts) through the existing pipeline; no new render variant needed.
5. **Testimonial treatment** — statementBody grows an evidentiary footer (attribution left, measured outcome in the money accent) when attribution + stat_value are both present. **PNG round 1 caught the row clipping at 1080w ("CLIENT PORTALS DELI") → tall formats now stack the footer.** The check-the-PNG law earns its keep again.
6. **Preview for all 10 brands** — the 7 orphaned `samples-brands` sets are wired into the preview route (`?set=<brand-slug>` + brand nav chips), Mirembe got its first ordinary editorial set (THE FIRM · PROOF OF WORK — claims from the source of truth + the two real R9,500 portals), statement samples added for varsityos/CN, and creativelynanda joined the vault filter and content-plan BRAND_ROLES.

entries.session: VelvetFist gets its own publishing lane — 5 posts a day (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body: The VelvetFist library is **done and past target**: 860 cards, every one captioned, every image already on Cloudinary (dossier 180 · warning 200 · negotiation 160 · mindset 160 · quote 160 — the target was 440). But **scheduled = 0, posted = 0**. Nothing had ever left the shelf, because nothing publishes VelvetFist. The gap was never design; it was distribution.

entries.session: VelvetFist gets its own publishing lane — 5 posts a day (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: The isolation problem, and how the lane solves it
entries.body:
The obvious move — route VelvetFist through the marketing publisher — is exactly what the hard rule forbids. That pipeline resolves accounts from a cross-brand map and shares a cron with every Mirembe brand; one config typo posts VelvetFist to the wrong account. So the lane is **deliberately duplicated, not shared**:
- **Its own credentials** (`VELVETFIST_IG_USER_ID` + `VELVETFIST_META_TOKEN`). A unit test asserts a shared `META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN` does **not** switch VelvetFist on.
- **Its own worker** (`studio/velvetfist-publish`, 15-minute cron) reading exactly one table.
- **Its own Graph client** — the duplication with `lib/marketing/meta.ts` is the point, not an oversight.
- **Dormant-safe**: with no keys it reports `blocked_on_key` and touches nothing, so the board still works as a manual checklist.

entries.session: VelvetFist gets its own publishing lane — 5 posts a day (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: The cadence — 5 a day, in daylight
entries.body: Even spacing would be a 4.8-hour gap that marches through the night and posts at 3am. Slots are laid inside a **SAST daytime window** and repeat daily instead: 5 a day lands at **08:00 · 11:00 · 14:00 · 17:00 · 20:00**. SAST is a fixed +2 with no DST, so the day maths needs no timezone library. Nothing is scheduled into the past — starting mid-afternoon simply begins at the next slot.

entries.session: VelvetFist gets its own publishing lane — 5 posts a day (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped
entries.body:
- `slotsFor()` (pure, tested), `publishVelvetCard()` (container → poll → publish), `velvetPublishConfigured()`.
- `POST /api/studio/velvetfist` — schedule a RUN: the next N cards of a style onto the cadence, oldest first, **skipping any card without an image or caption** rather than queueing a guaranteed failure. `dryRun` returns the plan without writing.
- Board UI: a **Schedule a run** panel (style · how many · 5 a day · first post · preview-then-commit) and a live lane badge — *Auto-posting live* vs *Manual — awaiting VelvetFist Instagram keys*.
- The worker records the IG post id on success; on failure it leaves the card `scheduled` to retry and writes the reason onto the card, so Zee sees it on the board rather than in logs.

entries.session: Brand textures — the material, not the photograph (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body: Nanda's idea: use each brand's own background images so a post is recognisable before a word is read. The instinct was right; the literal version would have been chaotic. Type colour (`--onfield`) is derived from a **flat** ground, so an un-treated photo makes contrast unpredictable — and mirembemuse.co.za had already solved this on the web with `BotanicalBackdrop` (image + veil). This ports that idea into the engine under two constraints.

entries.session: Brand textures — the material, not the photograph (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: The rules that make it work
entries.body:
1. **Text-only plates only** — cover, CTA, reels. A module already carries the cream panel, so a texture there is just noise around it. `case_study` is excluded too: its ivory sheet covers the ground.
2. **It blends into the ground, it doesn't sit under a scrim.** A flat veil over a dark field just lightens it and the material disappears (tested — invisible at 80% veil). `overlay` on dark grounds, `multiply` on paper ones, so the field keeps its exact hue.
3. **Never `screen` or `lighten`.** The contact sheet settled it: both wash Sanyu's burgundy toward mauve. The ground has to stay the brand colour, because that's what the text contrast was derived from.
4. Per-brand strength, and `texture:false` on any asset to opt out.

entries.session: Brand textures — the material, not the photograph (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped
entries.body:
- `BrandTokens.texture` (key) + `textureStrength`; `MagazineFields.texture:false` opts out.
- **Mirembe = `emerald-gold-leaves`** (literally its palette — emerald + Kingdom Gold) at 30%, a whisper suited to the firm. **Sanyu = `botanical-shadow`** at 34%, more present, which suits the apothecary register.
- `scripts/inline-textures.mjs` → `textures.generated.ts`. Textures are **inlined as data URIs** because the engine is deliberately self-contained (no network) and rasterises through `setContent`, where a root-relative path has nothing to resolve against. The rule is emitted **once per document as a CSS class**, not per asset — inlining per asset would repeat ~100 KB on every cover in a gallery.
- Only the curated top-level files in `public/textures/` are inlined and committed; the per-brand libraries (~19 MB, copies of each app repo) are gitignored.

entries.session: Brand textures — the material, not the photograph (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Gotchas
entries.body:
- Renaming the curated files without updating the token keys made `groundTexture` bail silently — six blend trials all rendered identically before I noticed the texture was never painting. **A contact sheet where every cell looks the same is a wiring bug, not a subtle effect.**
- The effect is strongest on CTA/text-heavy plates. On a cover the image plate covers most of the ground, so it reads as a top band.

entries.session: House of Mirembe — the remaining seven brands, and the specimen (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: The bug that mattered — my own inspector was lying
entries.body:
Thirteen assets across seven brands flagged "deck truncated", all the same shape. I widened two clamps on that evidence before checking the measurement itself: **`.deck` is a grown flex item (`flex:1 1 auto`), so in a tall panel its `scrollHeight` reports the stretched box, not the text** — a two-line deck measured as 4.87 lines. Every 16:9 module with a tall panel was a false positive. The inspector now releases the stretch (`flex:0 0 auto; height:auto`) before measuring, and **I reverted the deck clamp I had widened on bad evidence**. The headline clamp stays at 4 — that one was a real clip I'd seen in a PNG first.
- After the fix, six flags survived and were genuine: **a module deck over ~115 characters overflows the 16:9 panel**. Trimmed the copy rather than widening the clamp — the format is the constraint. Written into `samples-brands.ts` as a content law.

entries.session: House of Mirembe — the remaining seven brands, and the specimen (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Gotchas / lessons
entries.body:
- **Fix the instrument before you act on its readings.** Widening a clamp because the checker complained was backwards; the checker was wrong. The tell was the shape of the failure — one identical symptom across seven unrelated brands is never seven copywriting mistakes.
- `page.evaluate` still rejects named functions under tsx (`__name is not defined`) — anonymous arrows only, as the file comment says.

entries.session: House of Mirembe — brand 10: Creatively Nanda, the soul room (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Engine fixes this brand exposed (all cross-brand)
entries.body:

- **The placeholder plate slammed a near-black slab onto paper grounds** (`darken(field,.6)` regardless of ground) — it now tints down gently on light fields (`.12`), which is what makes a paper-forward brand possible at all.
- **`.f169 .headline` clamp 2 → 4.** Tuned to VarsityOS's short imperative headlines, it silently cut anything longer with a quarter of the panel empty. Verified no regression on the reference brands.

entries.session: House of Mirembe §7 — founder routing: which door a post sends people to (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body: The catalog's rule was *"founder content may funnel to Mirembe **or** Creatively Nanda"* — so every generated founder post picked its link by vibe, and one voice pointed at two doors. §0.5 of the brief settles it: CN and Mirembe are two rooms of one mind, and the room is chosen by **what the post is doing**, not by which account posted it.

entries.session: House of Mirembe §7 — founder routing: which door a post sends people to (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped (`src/lib/marketing/cta-catalog.ts`)
entries.body:
- **The front door and the creative room are now separate entries.** `nanda_personal` (Nanda Regine, voice `founder`) is the front door where the poet/engineer tension lives; `creativelynanda` (voice `poet`) is the soul room. They were one entry sharing a slug list, which is exactly why the routing could never be decided.
- **`PostIntent`** = `poet · craft · founder · engineer · institutional · product`, and **`routeFunnel(brand, intent)`**: poet/craft → creativelynanda.co.za · founder/engineer/institutional → mirembemuse.co.za · product → that product's own domain. **A product brand always keeps its own domain** — a VarsityOS post drives to VarsityOS even when the story is a founder story. Unknown brand → `null`, never a guessed link.
- **`inferIntent(text, brand)`** — keyword evidence per intent, most-hits wins, falling back to the brand's native reading (front door → founder, CN → poet, Mirembe → institutional) so a silent brief still routes somewhere defensible.
- **`catalogKeyFor(slug)`** exported so callers can tell "same room" from "cross room".
- **Wired into generation**: `buildBrandJuice(supabase, brand, { brief })` now emits the resolved destination, a one-line `WHY THERE:` rationale, and — when a post crosses rooms — borrows the **destination's** CTAs plus an explicit "do not pitch two destinations in one post". `batch-generate` passes the week's `content_brief`, so intent comes from real copy.
- The ambiguous `funnelNote` is gone from all three founder entries.

entries.session: Preview before publish — the last human gate on the magazine engine (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body: The magazine engine can now render a whole editorial set from one generated post and auto-publish it. That is exactly when a silently clipped headline becomes a public mistake — so nothing with visuals goes out until it has been *seen*, and until Chrome itself says it renders clean.

entries.session: Preview before publish — the last human gate on the magazine engine (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped
entries.body:
- **`inspect.ts` false-positive FIXED — the bug that would have made the gate useless.** The detector compared `scrollHeight` to `clientHeight`; on this engine the display faces run at ~0.98 line-height with negative letter-spacing, so glyph ink overflows the line box and **every nominal headline reported "truncated"**. A gate that cries wolf on clean copy gets ignored within a day. It now measures natural height with the clip removed and compares it to what the layout allows (`clamp × lineHeight`, else `max-height`), tolerance half a line; width is still measured untouched first, so a real nowrap overrun is never masked.
- **`gate.ts`** — the rule, as pure functions (no I/O, identical on server and client): a set is blocked while any asset is still rendering, is unseen (`previewed_at` null), or is flagged and not overridden. **A post with no assets is never blocked** — text-only publishing is untouched.
- **Inspection wired into the render worker** — `asset-render` now inspects every asset after rendering (own step, own browser, so a flaky inspection can't lose a finished render) and stores the report on the row.
- **Migration `marketing_assets_preview_gate`** (live) — `inspection` · `inspected_at` · `previewed_at` · `approved_at` · `override_note` + partial indexes for the review queue.
- **`/api/marketing/magazine/approve`** — GET the review queue (or one set + its gate), POST `seen` / `override` / `approve`. Reads are brand-scoped; **every write is owner-only** — clearing the publish gate is precisely what a collaborator must not be able to do. `approve` re-evaluates the gate server-side over the whole set and never trusts the client's view of readiness.
- **THE GATE ITSELF, in the publish path** — `PATCH /api/marketing/posts/[id]` now blocks `approved` and `scheduled` (the transition that pushes to Buffer) with a 422 naming the blockers.
- **`/dashboard/marketing/preview`** — the surface. Sets grouped by post, assets at true aspect ratio, per-asset verdict (`✓ renders clean` / `⚠ deck cut off` / `↷ cleared: <reason>`), unseen assets dimmed with "tap to review". **Opening an asset full-size IS the seen event** — Approve stays dead until every asset in the set has been opened. A flagged asset can still ship, but only with a written reason recorded on the row. Approving the set also advances the post draft → approved. Linked from the Marketing dashboard + Vault, and the Vault cards now carry `unseen` / `⚠ clipped` chips.
- **`scripts/check-inspect.mts`** — repeatable proof: sweeps every asset of both locked sets in all 3 ratios (must be CLEAN), plus +200% copy (must flag the right fields) and a dead image URL (must report imageMissing).

entries.session: Preview before publish — the last human gate on the magazine engine (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Gotchas / lessons
entries.body:

- `import type` everywhere in `gate.ts` — verified the emitted JS has zero runtime imports, so the browser bundle never pulls puppeteer.

entries.session: Server-side GA4 conversions — the write half of empire analytics (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body: GA4 showed real traffic on 5 properties and **zero conversions on every one of them** — because every payment finishes on the processor's domain, where no browser tag can ever see it. The read half (GA4 OAuth pipeline → `/dashboard/analytics`) was already live; this is the write half.

entries.session: Server-side GA4 conversions — the write half of empire analytics (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped
entries.body:
- **`src/lib/analytics/measurement-protocol.ts`** — dependency-free MP transport. Dormant-safe, self-timing-out, never throws (same contract as `posthog.ts`). Per-app secret resolved from `mpSecretEnv` in `apps.ts` — **first env var that is SET wins**, so a new app lights up the moment its key is dropped in, with no code change.
- **`src/lib/analytics/server-events.ts`** — the domain layer: `trackServerPurchase` / `trackServerLead` + `trackInBackground` (uses `waitUntil`, NOT bare `void` — Vercel freezes those). Dispatch is **reserve → send → correct**: insert the log row first to claim the dedupe key, send, then downgrade the row's status if the send failed (which frees the key for a retry).
- **Table `analytics_server_events`** — partial unique index on `(app_slug, event_name, dedupe_key) WHERE status IN ('sent','validated')`: the hard backstop against a retried ITN inflating GA4 revenue.
- **Wired into the real money paths** — PayFast `notify` (purchase, inside the fresh-booking branch so it inherits PayFast's own idempotency) · Paystack `webhook` bookCharge (purchase — renewals matter most here, no browser exists) · CEO `leads` POST + the Meta lead-ad worker (generate_lead).
- **UI** — `ServerTrackingPanel` on `/dashboard/analytics` + `GET/POST /api/os/analytics/server-events`: per-app credential state, recent dispatch log, and a Test button.

entries.session: Server-side GA4 conversions — the write half of empire analytics (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Gotchas / lessons
entries.body: - **Do not trust GA4's debug endpoint.** `/debug/mp/collect` validates the PAYLOAD ONLY. Verified live: it returns 200 with empty `validationMessages` for a bogus api_secret AND for a made-up measurement id. It can never prove credentials work — only a real send landing in Realtime does. The dashboard Test button therefore sends a real zero-value `jarvis_connection_test` event by default.

entries.session: Magazine engine — House of Mirembe design system: case_study variant + brand marks + law pass + overflow hardening (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Shipped (all in `src/lib/marketing/magazine/`)
entries.body:
- **Mirembe `case_study` variant** (Tier 1, new format) — the "specification sheet": a system diagram gets the largest area (it IS the argument), numbered evidence rows (Problem/Decision/Rationale) in a notes margin, a full-width gold outcome band (required real number), Ubuntu = a **K5 complete-graph seal** watermark. `CaseStudySchema` (schema.ts, the one nested field — diagram is inline SVG markup not a URL, stack is an array), `caseStudyBody`/`mirembeSeal` + law-clean CSS (render.ts), `samples-mirembe.ts` (real content = the render-engine's own headless-Chrome-vs-Canva fork from this journal), preview route `?set=mirembe-case`.
- **Per-brand vector marks** — `BrandTokens.mark?` = inline SVG in `currentColor`, rendered beside the wordmark in masthead + reel (`.mk` cap-height lockup). Done: VarsityOS = dog-eared handbook page; Mirembe = the K5 seal. Self-contained (works in PNG + artifact). `public/mirembe-logo.png` is the only raster logo and is deliberately NOT used (own-bg raster won't sit on varied grounds). User is gathering real logos to swap in later.
- **Image-load guard** (png.ts) — after load, checks `.wimg`/`.rbg` `naturalWidth>0`; on failure re-renders with `image:null` → branded placeholder + `console.warn`. A broken/404 URL never ships a blank plate. Verified with a deliberately-broken URL.
- **Base-engine LAW PASS** — removed every effect the brief bans everywhere: box-shadows (.panel/.well/.qrcard), gradients (.duo placeholder / .cap / .reel scrim), pills & large radii (→ 2px). New law-clean placeholder: flat `--plate` fill (`darken(field,.6)`) + hard keyline square + PHOTO_GLYPH/PLAY_GLYPH; reel scrim now solid rgba + `.fbot::before` solid lower-third bar for photo legibility.
- **Overflow hardening** (the user's #1 rule: text never cut off / overlapping) — `.ptop` flex-clip region wraps headline+deck above a `flex-shrink:0` stat footer; `.deck{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0}` so the DECK absorbs overflow and the headline is never clipped; f169 headline clamp 2, deck clamp 3; reclaimed margins (2.4→1.3-1.4cqi) so the real 3-line deck shows FULL; CTA `.big` 7→5.4cqi + `.col{overflow:hidden}`; cover big 8.2→6.7cqi (fixes a pre-existing 16:9 cover-headline clip).

entries.session: Magazine engine — House of Mirembe design system: case_study variant + brand marks + law pass + overflow hardening (July 27 2026)
entries.heading: Gotchas / lessons
entries.body:
- **Container-query (`cqi`) layouts on a fixed canvas overflow silently** — text clamps mid-word, grid rows collide; none of it shows in the HTML string or esbuild. MUST render to PNG and look. (Golden rule: always check the PNG.)
- **Check EVERY asset in a set, not just the first** — module 01 was clean but modules 02/04 (longer decks) clipped; the user caught it.
- To fit the real deck AND avoid an ugly mid-line clip: reclaim vertical room so nominal copy fits fully, then let genuine overflow truncate cleanly with `-webkit-line-clamp` ellipsis.
- `renderAssetPngs` batches on one browser; 6+ assets can exceed a 2-min shell timeout on a busy machine — render in small batches.

entries.session: POPIA compliance layer — legal spine for the funnel (July 22 2026)
entries.heading: Why
entries.body: Before scaling capture, the marketing machine must be lawful (POPIA — avoid §69 direct-marketing exposure + lawsuits/backlash).

entries.session: POPIA compliance layer — legal spine for the funnel (July 22 2026)
entries.heading: Built (technical safeguards)
entries.body:
- **`suppressions` table + `lib/growth/suppression.ts`** — ONE global do-not-contact list; an opt-out silences ALL brands/lists forever. **`isSuppressed()` now gates EVERY marketing send:** nurture welcome+drip (`sendStep`), magnet result, cold-outreach send (`/api/outreach/[id]`), follow-up cron.
- **Consent audit** — `subscribers.consent_at`/`consent_source` set on every capture (`subscribe.ts`).
- **One-click opt-out for COLD outreach** — `lib/growth/optout.ts` (HMAC-tokened, non-enumerable) → `GET /api/magnet/optout`; **sender-identity + opt-out footer** (`lib/growth/legal.ts coldEmailFooter`, "Mirembe Muse (Pty) Ltd · East London · Remove me · privacy") appended to outreach send + follow-ups (POPIA §69).
- **Global unsubscribe** — `/api/magnet/unsubscribe` now also `suppress()`es (across all lists).
- **Data-subject requests** — `POST /api/privacy/request` (public, allowlisted) records to `privacy_requests`, auto-suppresses, soft-deletes subscriber rows; business records flagged for owner review. Migration `20260722_popia_compliance.sql`.
- **Docs:** `PRIVACY_POLICY_TEMPLATE.md` (POPIA-aligned, placeholders, publish at /privacy per brand) + `POPIA_COMPLIANCE.md` (what's built vs the human/regulatory to-dos: register Information Officer, attorney review, PAIA manual, DPAs, consent checkboxes, set OPTOUT_SECRET).

entries.session: Funnel: cross-sync view + per-brand magnet engine (July 22 2026)
entries.heading: Per-brand magnet engine (one engine, three brands)
entries.body:
Same proven shape as the teardown (form on brand site → public Jarvis API → async AI → emailed result → capture + nurture), generalised via config:
- **`src/lib/growth/magnets/config.ts`** — `MAGNETS` registry: **sanyu-hair** (porosity→routine), **varsityos-bursary** (field/province→bursary game-plan), **k53-readiness** (test/weak-areas→readiness read). - **`POST /api/magnet/quiz`** — PUBLIC (CORS to all brand origins), IP rate-limited → captures subscriber + scored lead (brand-tagged, `magnet:<slug>`) → queues generation.
- **`src/inngest/growth/magnet-generate.ts`** — Haiku generates the result → branded email w/ CTA + valid tokened unsubscribe → starts the drip. Event `MAGNET_GENERATE`; registered.
- **To activate a brand magnet:** put the form on that brand's site (fields in config) pointing at `/api/magnet/quiz` {slug, answers, email, name} via a proxy (like Mirembe's `/api/teardown`), and add that brand's `/api/unsubscribe` proxy. entries.heading: Growth/Funnel cockpit — make the loop visible + shout when a pipe is dead
entries.body:
- `src/lib/growth/funnel.ts` — `getFunnelSnapshot()` reads the WHOLE loop across **both schemas** (public pipeline + `mirembe` capture) via `mirembeDb()`: capture (subscribers/quotes/messages/leads-by-source), qualify (leads by status + HOT ≥70 list), outreach (by status), convert (won), nurture (active subs + sequences). Best-effort per table. Emits **HEALTH FLAGS** — the point is to shout when a pipe is dead (0 inbound/30d → "verify Mirembe forwarding", 0 subscribers, empty outreach, N hot awaiting action) so a broken funnel can't quietly look fine.

entries.session: Visual Asset System — P1–P3: Field Manual Renderer + Vault (July 20 2026)
entries.heading: What & why
entries.body:
The empire's visual engine for multi-brand daily publishing. Plugs into the existing text arc (`brand_posts` / `VisualBrief`) — text already works; this renders it on-brand per-format per-ratio. Design language **LOCKED** with the user: **"VarsityOS // Field Manual"** digital-magazine editorial — color mat + cream text page + crop-to-fill image plate + figure-index numeral + masthead/folio + gold=money accent; heavy grotesque display / Georgia decks / monospace OS-voice.

**Origin insight (unblocked the whole design):** the reference magazine PNGs in the Canva vault were **designed in Claude** (HTML → exported PNG), so **Claude is the render engine — not Canva Bulk Create.** The Canva API can only fill/tag existing elements (`perform-editing-operations` has no insert-text/shape op) and `generate-design` returns generic stock — it cannot build this bespoke layout. Engine = **HYBRID** (Claude render for fidelity + automation; Canva push later for hand-tweak). Render tech = **headless Chrome** (pixel-perfect); MP4/reels deferred to a Remotion phase.

entries.session: Living Context Layer Complete + Unit Test Suite B1–B12 (June 19 2026)
entries.heading: Unit Test Suite — B1–B12
entries.body:
44 test files written across two sessions using Node 20 built-in test runner (`node:test`) and `tsx v4.22.3` for TypeScript transpilation without type-checking.

| Batch | Files | Tests |
|-------|-------|-------|
| B1–B10 | Schemas, stores, corpus chunker, XP catalog, waterfall, invoice HTML, sanitize, PayFast, portal lifecycle, Wings colors/images | ~200+ |
| B11 | `os/push`, `marketing/buffer`, `marketing/later` | 55 |
| B12 | `lib/api-response`, `os/signals` | 34 |

**Test runner setup:**
- No jest/vitest — plain `node --import tsx --test <files>`
- Relative imports (`../../../../src/lib/`) to avoid `@/` alias collisions in test files
- Redis monkey-patched with in-memory `Record<string, StoredValue>` store
- `global.fetch` mocked to capture URL/headers/body
- Env vars saved in `beforeEach`, restored in `afterEach`

**Test scripts in package.json:**
```json
"test:b11": "node --import tsx --test tests/unit/lib/os/push.test.ts tests/unit/lib/marketing/buffer.test.ts tests/unit/lib/marketing/later.test.ts",
"test:b12": "node --import tsx --test tests/unit/lib/api-response.test.ts tests/unit/lib/os/signals.test.ts"
```

**Test ceiling:** Files that require ESM module interception (Supabase query mocking at the function-call level) can't be tested with node:test — this is the natural ceiling. Affected: `xp/engine.ts`, `os/energy-budget.ts`, `autobiography/corpus-query.ts`.

entries.session: Finance Wing — P&L Cockpit + VAT201 Tracker + Receipt OCR (June 14 2026)
entries.heading: Bug Fixes
entries.body:
**Receipt route — raw Anthropic instantiation + wrong model ID**
`src/app/api/finance/expense/receipt/route.ts` had two violations of the JarvisOS singleton pattern:
1. Hardcoded `'claude-haiku-4-5'` (missing date suffix) — would silently fall back to wrong model version at runtime.
2. `new Anthropic({ apiKey: [REDACTED — Assigned credential] })` bypassed the singleton, creating a new client per request.
Fixed: replaced with `getHaikuClient()` + imported `HAIKU_MODEL` from `@/lib/anthropic`.

**4 cascade workers — deprecated 3-arg Inngest createFunction**
`body/cascade-intensity-update.ts`, `ceo/cascade-scheduling-update.ts`, `marketing/cascade-tone-update.ts`, `sanctuary/cascade-prompt-update.ts` all used the old 3-argument API `createFunction(config, trigger, handler)`. Inngest v4 requires 2 arguments with triggers inside the config object. Converted all four.

**intelligence-rss.ts — Set returned from step.run**
`step.run()` serializes its return value to JSON for checkpointing. Returning `new Set(...)` lost all data (Set serialises to `{}`), causing TypeScript to infer `EmptyObject`. Fixed: step returns a plain string array; `new Set()` constructed outside the step.

**intelligence/[id]/save route — missing fragment_id in select**
The `.select()` call did not include `fragment_id`, so `item.fragment_id` was undefined at runtime and a TypeScript error at compile time. Added to the select string.

**language-lesson.ts — betas field + unknown[] Json cast**
`messages.create()` (non-beta path) does not accept a `betas` property. Also used `cachedSystemBlock` (returns `BetaTextBlockParam`) in a non-beta call. Fixed: removed `betas`, changed system to plain string, user content to plain string. `quiz_questions` cast from `unknown[]` to `Json[]` (imported from `@/types/supabase`).

entries.heading: Inngest Workers — `language-lesson.ts`
entries.body:
Two functions:
1. **`languageLessonGenerate`** — event `scholar/language.lesson-generate` (on-demand from API): generates for a specific language/lesson_number. Sonnet for Luganda (heritage depth), Haiku for French/Zulu/Afrikaans.
2. **`languageLessonDailyCron`** — cron 08:00 SAST, Luganda + French + Zulu, skips if today's lesson already exists.

Lesson format (JSON stored in lesson_body, quiz extracted to quiz_questions):
- `grammar_concept` — specific topic title
- `explanation` — 3-4 sentences, culturally grounded
- `examples` — 3 items: target phrase + English + cultural note
- `practice_sentences` — 2 complete sentence pairs
- `quiz` — 5 multiple-choice questions (4 options each, `correct` index)

Difficulty scales with lesson_number: 1-10 = absolute basics, 11-30 = elementary, 31-60 = beginner, 61+ = lower-intermediate.

entries.body:
- `GET /api/scholar/language/lesson?language=X` — today's lesson (since 00:00 UTC)
- `POST /api/scholar/language/lesson` — on-demand generation; returns existing if today's already generated
- `POST /api/scholar/language/lesson/[id]/complete` — submit quiz score (0-100), marks status complete

entries.heading: Inngest Worker — `ceo-lesson-generate.ts`
entries.body:
Trigger: `scholar/ceo-lesson.generate` event. Steps: fetch book+track → gather live context (cycle phase, finance signal, open leads from Redis+DB) → Sonnet lesson generation with personalized business context → save to DB.

Lesson format (JSON from Sonnet):
- `concept` — 2-3 sentences, the book idea being explored
- `body` — 400-600 words: ## The Concept (5 min) / ## Applied to YOUR Business (5 min) / ## This Week's Action (3 min)
- `reflection_prompt` — one powerful question to sit with
- `action_item` — one concrete action doable TODAY under 30 minutes

Each lesson references Mirembe Muse, Sanyu Botanicals, or JarvisOS by name. Not generic summaries.

- `POST /api/scholar/ceo-curriculum/lesson` — create placeholder + fire Inngest (returns immediately, polls for content)
- `POST /api/scholar/ceo-curriculum/lesson/[id]/complete` — mark complete, store reflection notes + mastery score (0–100)

entries.heading: Finance Chat — Tool Calling (Anthropic tool_use API)
entries.body:
`src/app/api/finance/chat/route.ts` — added 2 tools to the Sonnet call:

| Tool | Query | Filters |
|------|-------|---------|
| `get_my_transactions` | `transactions` table | limit (1–20), direction (in/out), category (partial match) |
| `get_savings_goals` | `savings_goals` table | all active goals with current_zar progress |

Pattern: first Sonnet call includes `tools: FINANCE_TOOLS`. If `stop_reason === 'tool_use'`, execute all tools in parallel (direct Supabase query), build `tool_result` array, make second Sonnet call with tool results — return final text. Finance advisor can now answer "what did I spend on food this month?" or "how close am I to my emergency fund goal?" with live data.

entries.heading: Health check logic
entries.body:
- `up` — HTTP 200–299 AND response_ms < 2000ms
- `degraded` — HTTP 200–299 AND response_ms ≥ 2000ms, OR HTTP 3xx–4xx
- `down` — HTTP 5xx, timeout (8s), DNS failure
- Alert deduplication: no new APP_DOWN alert if one already exists and is unactioned
- Tier 1 (adminos, varsityos, stokvelos): severity=critical on down, 2h expiry
- Tier 2 (k53drillmaster, creativelynanda): severity=high on down, 4h expiry
- Tier 3 (watchsankofa, sankofasessions): severity=high on down, 4h expiry

entries.heading: Redis signals
entries.body:
- `engineering:health:snapshot:{userId}` — current app statuses (30 min TTL)
- `signals:engineering:{userId}` — cross-wing signal for morning brief (1h / 24h TTL)
- `engineering:digest:{userId}` — daily digest (24h TTL)

entries.heading: Architecture decisions
entries.body:
- **retries: 0 on health-check** — stale health result worse than no result; worker is idempotent
- **HEAD requests** — faster than GET, follows redirects, consistent with real browser path
- **Alert deduplication** — DB query before insert prevents spam during sustained outage
- **Haiku for security scan** — classification/pattern-detection is Haiku territory; Sonnet reserved for strategic decisions
- **Prompt caching** — ENGINEERING_SYSTEM_PROMPT is 4096+ tokens; cached system block saves ~80% on weekly scan cost
- **30-day retention** — health checks pruned weekly; security_events retained indefinitely

entries.body:
- **Sonnet everywhere** — all Scholar work is intellectual synthesis; Haiku is never used in this wing

Goal
entries.body: Build the complete Body Wing: fitness tracking, HRV/recovery scoring, nutrition intelligence, and cross-wing cycle phase sync. Haiku-only AI persona. 14-commit sequence.

entries.heading: Architecture decisions
entries.body:
**Model routing:** Haiku-ONLY for all body AI (recovery alerts, daily summaries, chat). Body data is structured and formulaic — no Sonnet needed.

**Recovery score algorithm:**
```
baseline 50
+ HRV contribution: (hrv_ms / baseline_hrv - 1) × 25, clamped ±25
+ sleep contribution: (sleep_hours - 6) × 5, clamped ±15
+ quality contribution: (sleep_quality - 5) × 2, clamped ±10
final = clamp(50 + hrv_delta + sleep_delta + quality_delta, 0, 100)
```

**External APIs (zero-cost):**
- Open Food Facts — `https://world.openfoodfacts.org/cgi/search.pl` — no key
- Wger Exercise DB — `https://wger.de/api/v2/exercise/` — no key, language=2 (English)
- OpenWeather — East London coords (-33.0153, 27.9116), 3hr UV index + conditions

**Cross-wing signals:**
- Body emits → `jarvis:signals:body:{userId}`: `{ recovery_score, sleep_hours, training_sessions, alert, alert_advice }`
- Body consumes ← `jarvis:signals:cycle:{userId}`: `cycle_phase`, `cycle_day` for phase-aware guidance
- CEO morning brief extended to read `jarvis:signals:body:{userId}`
- Cycle daily worker extended to trigger `body/phase.sync` on phase change

entries.heading: Key design decisions
entries.body:
- **AES-256-GCM** chosen over CBC — authenticated encryption prevents ciphertext tampering; IV+TAG+ciphertext stored together in Storage as a single blob
- **Evidence pack cover letter** generated inline in POST `/api/docs/evidence-pack` — Sonnet call blocks response, user gets the letter immediately without polling

entries.session: Phase 16: Wing 10 v2 — Body Intelligence Expansion
entries.heading: Key design decisions
entries.body:
- **4 new Supabase tables** built on top of v1 foundation: `body_measurements`, `movement_disciplines`, `discipline_sessions`, `nervous_system_logs`
- **WHR computed server-side** — waist-to-hip ratio calculated in GET /api/body/measurements; ideal < 0.85 for women flagged with color status
- **week_mins enrichment pattern** — disciplines GET does a second query on `discipline_sessions`, then computes `week_mins` + `last_session` in JS rather than SQL to avoid complex joins
- **Polyvagal Theory integration** — 3 NS states: `ventral_vagal` (safe/social), `sympathetic` (fight/flight), `dorsal_vagal` (freeze/shutdown). Dominant state fed into monthly composition analysis
- **9 preset arts** auto-populate disciplines page: Krav Maga, Boxing, Kung Fu, Tai Chi, MMA (martial_arts); Heels Dancing, Belly Dance, Hip Hop, Salsa (dance). Quick-add chips only show missing arts
- **GoalRing SVG** — animated `strokeDasharray` ring showing weekly progress % per discipline
- **Phase-aware intelligence** — follicular phase = neuroplasticity peak for learning new arts; luteal late = restorative only. Cycle phase pulled from Redis `jarvis:signals:cycle:{userId}`
- **Monthly composition Inngest** — 1st of month 07:00 UTC, Haiku analyses 30-day measurement delta + dominant NS state. Stored in Redis `jarvis:body:monthly-analysis:{userId}` (30d TTL)
- **Weekly discipline Inngest** — Monday 08:00 UTC, per-user discipline report with NS context. Stored in Redis `jarvis:body:weekly-report:{userId}` (7d TTL)
- **3 Notion databases** created: Body Measurements, Movement Disciplines, Nervous System Logs — IDs wired into `.env.local`
- **v1 migration applied first** — v2 `ALTER TABLE training_sessions` required v1 tables to exist. Both migrations applied to JarvisOS Supabase project `ywkbuqqlnuyidqseymrl`

entries.heading: TypeScript Zero-Error Audit (all 15 wings)
entries.body:
After completing Wings 13–15, ran `npx tsc --noEmit` to validate the full codebase. Fixed 15+ cross-wing TypeScript errors:

| Error | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| `body_measurements` / `movement_disciplines` / `nervous_system_logs` not in Supabase types | `supabase as any` with inline row typedefs |
| `cycle_logs.day_of_cycle` → correct column | Fixed to `cycle_day` (matches live DB schema) |
| `Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to BodyInit | `new Uint8Array(decrypted)` in download route |
| `Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` vs `Buffer<ArrayBuffer>` | Cast `result.encrypted as Buffer<ArrayBuffer>` |
| `Record<string,unknown>` not assignable to Supabase update type | `updates as any` in classify-route |
| `user_id: string \| undefined` in board_actions insert | `reminderActions as any` after `.filter(a => a.user_id)` |
| `EVENTS.CLIENT_ONBOARD_START as const` on variable reference (TS1355) | Removed invalid `as const` |
| `Set<string>` spread requires downlevelIteration (TS2802) | `Array.from(prev)` before spreading |
| Zustand v5 full-state destructuring loses v2 properties | Individual selectors `useBodyStore(s => s.field)` |
| Notion API `props as Record<string,unknown>` incompatible | `props as any` |
| Sankofa notion-sync DB row vs app type mismatch | `record as unknown as AppType` with explicit imports |
| `m.due_date` possibly null in milestone filter (TS18047) | Added `m.due_date &&` null guard |

**Result:** `npx tsc --noEmit` exits with code 0. Zero TypeScript errors across all 15 wings.

entries.heading: Component (`src/components/goddess/GoddessSidebar.tsx`)
entries.body:
Floating overlay, 440+ lines. Mounted inside `JarvisShell` (all wings inherit it automatically).

**Closed state:** 56×56px mood-colored orb, bottom-right corner. Glowing box-shadow in current mood color. Badge shows elapsed session time when a session is active.

**Open state:** 320px right-side panel, two view tabs.

**Day Arc view:**
- Wisdom quote (mood-mapped)
- Today's schedule items (time + wing emoji + title + context)
- Cycle phase + energy forecast chips
- Session start buttons: Free Flow (no timebox) / Eagle Eye (25m) / Deep Work (custom: 25m / 50m / 90m selector)

**Session view:**
- Session name + mode badge
- Timebox progress bar (green → red when elapsed ≥ timebox)
- Task checklist — tap to toggle → calls `PATCH /api/goddess/session/[id]` action=update-tasks immediately
- Eagle Eye 25-min check-in panel: energy slider 1–5 + text note → `PATCH` action=checkin
- End Session: selects end_mood (drained / neutral / energised / in-flow) + end_energy → `PATCH` action=end → resets store to orb view

**Wing detection:** `wingFromPath(pathname)` regex on current route — passed to session POST so each session knows which wing it ran in.

entries.session: Phase 8: Goddess Interface — Day Arc, Session Mode, Eagle Eye
entries.heading: Architecture decisions
entries.body:
- **Haiku for Day Arc generation** — schedule items are templated/contextual, not strategic; Haiku is the right tier
- **Day Arc cached in DB** — upserted once per day (`UNIQUE(user_id, arc_date)`); never re-generated within the same day unless manually triggered
- **Checkins as JSONB array** — appended in API route (not SQL trigger) to keep full history per session without a separate table
- **Tasks synced immediately on toggle** — no "save tasks" button; every checkbox tap persists to DB
- **Mood is derived from cycle phase** — not user-selected; ensures the interface reflects actual biology, not preference
- **Orb elapsed timer uses `Date.now()` diff** — no server polling; client computes elapsed from `started_at` ISO string
- **TSC: 0 errors** — confirmed after all Phase 8 files
